shortDescription: UPPSC PCS Syllabus 2026 – Prelims GS & CSAT; Mains Hindi, Essay, GS and Optional papers with UP-specific topics.
content:
UPPSC PCS has three stages. Syllabus is published with the Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services notification.

Prelims

  • Paper I – General Studies (200 marks): Current events, History of India & National Movement, Indian & World Geography, Indian Polity & Governance, Economic & Social Development, Environment, General Science, UP specific knowledge.
  • Paper II – CSAT (200 marks, qualifying 33%): Comprehension, Interpersonal skills, Logical reasoning, Decision making, General mental ability, Elementary maths (Class X), Hindi language comprehension (Class X).

Mains (conventional / written)

  • General Hindi
  • Essay
  • General Studies papers (as per latest scheme – History, Polity, Economy, Science, Ethics, UP affairs etc.)
  • Optional subject – two papers

Interview follows Mains. Always use the syllabus annexure of the current year advt (e.g. A-1/E-1/2026) on uppsc.up.nic.in.
